t2.thesis: Deep pre-earnings de-risking and elevated short interest create an asymmetric setup where Reddit's compressed valuation can spark a relief rally on solid monetization and steady Q4 guidance.
reasons: RDDT shares dropped 11.7% over the past 5 sessions and sit 48% below 52-week highs, pricing in significant deceleration in US user growth.
Valuation has compressed to ~14x forward earnings with operating margins near 29% and cash flow exceeding $260M quarterly.
Short interest of nearly 15% of float provides high short-squeeze fuel if Q3 results hit the $860-$870M revenue guidance and Q4 holiday ad demand holds up.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance and indications that international ARPU expansion is compensating for slowing domestic user growth.
t2.leak_probe: I don't know, as October 29, 2026, is in the future.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up +0.01 from prior 0.54 due to significant pre-earnings selloff, low hurdle rate on sentiment, and strong profitability offset by persistent US DAUq growth concerns.

theses.expected: Q3 revenue and EBITDA beat guidance midpoint ($865M/$390M) and Q4 guidance reflects healthy holiday ad spend, sparking a 5-10% relief rally.
theses.mechanism: Short covering against high 14.9% short float combined with multiple expansion from depressed 14x forward P/E.
theses.wrong_if: Management warns of further softening in direct response advertising or broader ad spending deceleration into Q4.

theses.expected: US DAUq growth stabilizes near 5-7% while ARPU increases over 30% YoY, showing Reddit's high-intent community value.
theses.mechanism: Market refocuses on rapid commercial monetization and AI data licensing potential rather than pure top-of-funnel DAU scale.
theses.wrong_if: Search engine algorithm changes trigger an outright contraction in quarterly active users or ad load saturation.

theses.expected: Q3 results meet baseline expectations but conservative Q4 guidance causes another sharp drop mirroring Q2's -18% reaction.
theses.mechanism: High sensitivity to top-line decelerations among growth tech investors leading to continuous multiple derating.
theses.wrong_if: Aggressive share repurchases and robust free cash flow support the stock price at the open.

key_observations: Q3 reported revenue vs guidance range of $860M to $870M
US DAUq and Rest of World DAUq YoY growth rates
Global ARPU growth and ad pricing trends
Adjusted EBITDA margin relative to Q3 target of ~44-45%
